The '''Throne Chamber''' was a chamber in the [[Caverns of the Hidden One]] where [[The Hidden One|the leader]] of the [[Hidden Ones]] would sit. [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|A duel]] took place here in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] between [[Koro Ziil]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
